tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms condition apply as per tender document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years achieved in at east two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs 25.00 Lakhs

Each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years satisfactory completion as a prime contractor for at least one similar work such as Operated and Maintained water supply scheme for the period of one year of value not less than Rs 15 Lakhs

Tenderers must have valid PF & ESI registration certificates OR the tenderer shall submit a certificate stating the manpower hire agency along with PF & ESI registration certificates from whom the tendered will hire the man power for this work
Tenderers shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by the Government of Karnataka
